name: Akrapovič
note: Official Sponsor of the Ducati Lenovo Team: on Ducati's partner page its logo, which links to akrapovic.com, stands under 'Official Sponsors' with the line 'Exhaust systems' (Wayback Machine captures of 23 May and 18 Sep 2026); also a MotoGP partner of Red Bull KTM (ktm.com partner logos). Left unrated: the brand belongs to Akrapovič d.d. of Ivančna Gorica, Slovenia (akrapovic-ownership), but who holds the unlisted company isn't sourced (founder Igor Akrapovič is reported to control it; no citable statement found).
